item.title: Canadian glass-tech firm announces major Wilmington expansion
item.description: WILMINGTON, NC (WWAY-TV) – A new high-tech glass manufacturing company plans to expand its operations in Wilmington. Advanced Glazings is a Canadian-based company that specializes in glass insulation and natural light diffusion. The manufacturer plans to build a new campus in the Wilmington area in the near future. item.title: Putin calls talks with US on ending the Ukraine war ‘useful’ but also ‘difficult work’
item.description: Russian President Vladimir Putin said his five-hour talks with U.S. envoys on ending the war in Ukraine were “necessary” and “useful” but also “difficult work,” with some of the proposals unacceptable to the Kremlin.
